Architecture overview

From arbitrary HTML to native WordPress.

A deterministic conversion stack turns static website artifacts into editable pages and a conventional block theme. Each layer has one job, every handoff is inspectable, and quality evidence flows back into the transformer.

WordPress Editable site native pages block theme

HTML is the interchange format

Generators can produce the web format they already understand. The conversion layer handles WordPress structure.

Contracts separate responsibilities

Blocks Engine describes the desired site. Static Site Importer performs WordPress mutations.

The conversion pipeline

Four bounded stages. One inspectable result.

No product-specific prompt has to understand block serialization, theme files, or WordPress mutation order.

  1. 1

    Source artifact

    Accept normal web inputs

    A single HTML document, an HTML and asset tree, a ZIP, Markdown content, or a generated website artifact enters through a bounded intake path. Figma follows the same architecture after its own transformer produces a static HTML artifact.

    • HTML
    • CSS
    • Assets
    • Markdown
    • Site artifact v1
    ProducesNormalized source tree
  2. 2

    Blocks Engine

    Compile semantics, structure, and assets

    The generic artifact compiler separates document chrome from page content, maps representable HTML semantics to block markup, assigns canonical routes, declares assets and runtime requirements, and records conversion diagnostics.

    • Core block conversion
    • Shared header and footer extraction
    • Asset and script declarations
    • Quality and fallback diagnostics
    Produceswordpress-site-plan/v2
  3. 3

    Static Site Importer

    Materialize the canonical plan

    The WordPress layer validates the destination before mutation, resolves declared asset tokens, writes the block theme, creates or updates pages, applies ordered site operations, prepares declared dependencies, and records exactly what changed.

    • Pages store body blocks in post_content
    • Theme parts own shared chrome
    • Templates render core/post-content
    • Receipt records pages, files, and operations
    ProducesWordPress site + receipt
  4. 4

    Fixture matrix and validation providers

    Measure the result in the real editor

    The imported site is evaluated as a WordPress site, not as a successful function call. Browser rendering, editor validity, native block composition, missing assets, runtime behavior, and visual parity are collected as separate evidence.

    • Frontend and mobile rendering
    • Editor-open and block-validity checks
    • Native versus fallback composition
    • Source-to-WordPress visual comparison
    Feeds backAttributed findings

The stable handoff

The plan says what. The materializer decides where.

blocks-engine/wordpress-site-plan/v2 is destination-independent. It contains canonical block markup and desired-state operations without guessing a deployed theme URL or reaching into WordPress.

Blocks Engine never writes WordPress state. Static Site Importer never reverse-engineers compiler intent.

Quality is an output

“Imported” is not the finish line.

A useful result is editable, valid, complete, and visually faithful. The matrix keeps those dimensions separate so a green process exit cannot disguise a broken page.

Native

Semantic content becomes core blocks whenever the editor can represent it faithfully.

03

Convertible

Intentional runtime

Unresolved fallback

Treat visible core/html as a quality finding, not invisible success.

Maintenance model

Core evolves. The corpus tells us what to change.

The system is maintained as generic conversion capabilities and versioned contracts, not a growing set of templates for individual sites. When Gutenberg gains a useful block or attribute, Blocks Engine can adopt it and replay the same fixture corpus.

  1. 1
    Observe

    A fixture exposes a fallback, invalid block, missing behavior, or visual mismatch.

  2. 2
    Attribute

    Evidence separates transformer defects, real Gutenberg gaps, runtime islands, and style drift.

  3. 3
    Improve upstream

    The owning generic layer gains a semantic rule, contract capability, or typed block.

  4. 4
    Replay

    The full corpus proves the improvement and protects every previously solved site.

Architecture questions

The short answers.

Is the conversion a list of hard-coded site rules?

No. Conversion logic targets reusable HTML semantics, CSS and layout patterns, block capabilities, and typed artifact contracts. The fixture corpus is evidence and regression coverage; fixture identity is not an input to conversion.

What happens as Gutenberg adds or changes blocks?

The Blocks Engine mapping layer adopts the new core capability, then the corpus is replayed to measure native conversion, editor validity, and parity. The destination-independent site-plan boundary keeps that change out of product callers and materializers.

Why generate HTML before blocks?

HTML and CSS are broadly understood by design tools, browsers, generators, and language models. Keeping generation and conversion separate lets each improve independently while the fixture matrix measures the complete path.

When is a custom block justified?

Only after recurring fixture evidence shows that core blocks have no faithful semantic or behavioral path. The candidate then needs a typed schema, explicit runtime owner, provider decision, and acceptance evidence.

The goal

Generate freely. Convert deterministically. Edit natively.

The architecture turns every import into both a WordPress site and a measurement of what the block platform can express next.
